latest_release.name: v0.42.1 — fix component resolution in `from_pretrained` to prevent `trust_remote_code` bypass
latest_release.body:
This is a security release. See [GHSA-4prv-5hj7-c2xr](https://github.com/huggingface/diffusers/security/advisories/GHSA-4prv-5hj7-c2xr) for details.

This patch release fixes how a component's declared library name is resolved when loading with `from_pretrained`.

Pipelines and models declare each component as a `["<library>", "<class>"]` pair in `model_index.json` / `config.json`. This release changes how that library name is resolved across the `DiffusionPipeline`, `AutoModel`, and `ModularPipeline` loading paths, and adds a clearer error when the declared class is not found in the resolved module.

All users on 0.42.0 are encouraged to upgrade:

```
pip install diffusers==0.42.1
```

detail.readme_excerpt: 🤗 Diffusers is the go-to library for state-of-the-art pretrained diffusion models for generating images, audio, and even 3D structures of molecules. Whether you're looking for a simple inference solution or training your own diffusion models, 🤗 Diffusers is a modular toolbox that supports both. Our library is designed with a focus on [usability over performance](https://huggingface.co/docs/diffusers/conceptual/philosophy#usability-over-performance), [simple over easy](https://huggingface.co/docs/diffusers/conceptual/philosophy#simple-over-easy), and [customizability over abstractions](https://huggingface.co/docs/diffusers/conceptual/philosophy#tweakable-contributorfriendly-over-abstraction). 🤗 Diffusers offers three core components: - State-of-the-art [diffusion pipelines](https://huggingface.co/docs/diffusers/api/pipelines/overview) that can be run in inference with just a few lines of code. - Interchangeable noise [schedulers](https://huggingface.co/docs/diffusers/api/schedulers/overview) for different diffusion speeds and output quality. - Pretrained [models](https://huggingface.co/docs/diffusers/api/models/overview) that can be used as building blocks, and combined with schedulers, for creating your own end-to-end diffusion systems. ## Installation We recommend installing 🤗 Diffusers in a virtual environment from PyPI or Conda.
